title: A lost route to the source host fails checks falsely
symptom: Silver checks failed with an empty source side; ssh timed out
cause: The laptop's route to the VM dropped for more than the retries' 11 minutes
notes: Again on 2026-10-25, overnight: more than 2 hours, so a run with the 120-minute retry still failed (Oracle TPC-DI), and its host folder on the VM was then missing (statfs ... no such file or directory: cause not known). Runs whose retries outlasted it carried on (Db2 TPC-E). Long runs shouldn't start before the laptop sleeps, or should run on a host that doesn't
